# BuildCost GH — Full Site Documentation

## Overview
BuildCost GH provides accurate, real-time construction cost estimates for building projects in Ghana. The platform serves Ghanaians and the global African diaspora planning to build or invest in real estate in Ghana. Estimates are based on current market rates for materials and labor across all 16 regions.

## What We Offer

### Construction Cost Calculator
Free instant estimates for any building project. Choose from house types (2-bedroom, 3-bedroom, 4-bedroom, bungalow, duplex, mansion), estimate by room, materials, or all-in cost. No credit card required.

- **House Type Calculator**: Full project cost for standard house types
- **Room-by-Room Calculator**: Cost breakdown per room
- **Material Calculator**: Individual material costs and quantities
- **All-In Calculator**: Complete project estimate with materials + labor

### Pricing
- **Basic Report** — $29 one-time (detailed cost breakdown for one project)
- **Pro Subscription** — $79/month (unlimited estimates, priority support)
- **Enterprise** — $499/month (custom integrations, dedicated support)
- Free 3-day trial available on Pro plan
- Payments via card or mobile money (Momos)

### Services
- **Cost Reports**: Detailed line-item reports with material and labor breakdowns
- **Contractor Matching**: Connect with verified contractors in your region
- **Project Monitoring**: Track project progress against budget
- **Material Price Alerts**: Get notified when key material prices change
- **Design Consultation**: Professional architect and engineer referrals

### Contractor Directory
Verified contractors across all 16 regions of Ghana. Each listing includes:
- Company name and contact information
- Regions served
- Rating and reviews
- Portfolio/project count
- Response time

### Blog
30+ articles covering Ghana construction topics:
- Cost guides for all house types (2-bedroom through luxury mansion)
- Material pricing and trends (cement, steel, roofing, etc.)
- Regional cost comparisons across all 16 regions
- Step-by-step construction guides
- Foundation and roofing cost guides
- Budget planning and financing advice
- Permits and legal requirements

## How It Works
1. **Choose your project** — Select house type or custom build
2. **Get an instant estimate** — AI-powered calculation based on real Ghana market data
3. **Review and customize** — Adjust materials, finishes, and location
4. **Get your report** — Download detailed PDF or subscribe for unlimited access

## Technical Documentation

### API
REST API for integrating construction cost estimates into third-party platforms:
- Authentication via API keys
- Real-time cost calculations
- Usage tracking dashboard
- Rate limiting and caching

### Stack
- Next.js 14 (App Router)
- Prisma + PostgreSQL
- Paystack payments
- UploadThing file uploads
- Resend email delivery
- OpenAI integration

## Legal
- **Terms of Service**: Standard SaaS terms with focus on estimate accuracy disclaimers
- **Privacy Policy**: GDPR-compliant data handling
- **Cookie Policy**: Analytics and functional cookies with consent management
- **Disclaimer**: Estimates are for planning purposes; actual costs vary
- **Refund Policy**: 14-day money-back guarantee on reports
